summary.text: Liz May is a Republican state representative from District 27 who took office in January 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She was previously a member of the House from 2013 to 2019.

paragraphs.text: Liz May, also known as Elizabeth May, earned a degree in adjusting from the Texas Property and Casualty Insurance School, according to Ballotpedia.
Her career experience includes working as a rancher and owning a business.
May represented South Dakota House District 27 from 2013 to 2019 and assumed office again on January 12, 2021.
In the 2025-2026 session, she serves on the House Appropriations Committee.
